title: CSV Contract Preflight input
description: Paste a UTF-8 CSV and the JSON contract it should follow. The form is prefilled with a synthetic sample.

contractJson.title: Contract JSON
contractJson.description: Up to 8,000 UTF-8 bytes. Declare column order, string and integer types, required fields, and an optional literal primary key.

csvText.title: CSV text
csvText.description: Paste up to 20,000 UTF-8 bytes and 500 data records. The first record is the header. Keep IDs in their original spelling.
